answer: WNT2+ and PEAR1+ prenatal fibroblasts express genes involved in cellular senescence (CDKN1A), cytokine pathways (e.g. IL1R1), and collagen deposition (e.g. POSTN); they also show an increased adult-like fibroblast gene expression profile and, during the transition from HOXC5+ fibroblasts to PEAR1+ fibroblasts, upregulate pro-inflammatory phenotype genes (APOE, IGFBP7 and ITM2A).
support_quote: Notably, WNT2 + and PEAR1 + prenatal fibroblasts expressed several genes involved in cellular senescence (CDKN1A), cytokine pathways (for example, IL1R1) and collagen deposition (for example, POSTN) (Fig. 3a,b), which are highly expressed in pathogenic fibroblasts of fibrotic skin disorders 53 .
